1-3.narrative: discovery, repetition, sound, physical interaction; no problem required

exact_age_calibration.1: 8-20 words per spread; 96-240 total; concrete nouns and actions; strong sound/repetition; one idea per spread; very simple dialogue; no abstract reasoning required
exact_age_calibration.2: 12-25 words per spread; 144-300 total; concrete discovery and movement; short dialogue; simple anticipation and repetition
exact_age_calibration.3: 15-30 words per spread; 180-360 total; connected experience story; simple cause/effect; counting, pattern, or tiny objective when supplied by the fixed plot

4-5.narrative: one small problem/objective; 2-3 simple reasoning steps; active child

6-7.narrative: one central problem; 2+ decisions; first attempt may fail; new info changes plan

8-10.narrative: clues/evidence, competing ideas, revision and verification
